players.product: Siyuan (MLU) cloud AI chips and accelerator cards, AI servers and intelligent computing cluster systems for large-model training and inference

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: operating revenue RMB 6,497,196,198.68, up 453.21% from RMB 1,174,464,377.35, which the company attributes to continuously rising AI compute demand and its market expansion; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,059,228,538.67 versus a loss of RMB 452,338,791.01 in 2024 (its first full-year profit); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,769,934,157.68; gross margin 55.15% (down 1.56 percentage points); operating cash flow RMB -498,398,137.01. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 1,111,398,926.80, Q2 RMB 1,769,244,544.29, Q3 RMB 1,726,780,892.57, Q4 RMB 1,889,771,835.02; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 454,582,794.56.

2025 revenue by product line: cloud product line (cloud AI chips and boards, AI servers) RMB 6,476,855,244.59, up 455.34%, gross margin 55.22%; edge product line RMB 3,393,986.73, down 48.12%; IP licensing and software RMB 2,288,749.93. Domestic revenue RMB 6,497,129,116.33 (nearly 100%); direct sales 99.13% of revenue. AI chips and boards: production 127,673 pieces (+409.84%), sales 117,436 pieces (+201.57%), inventory 857,057 pieces (+0.63%). Packaging and test cost RMB 343,742,389.75 (11.80% of cost of sales, +436.17%); direct materials 50.40%. The company says its products were deployed at scale in telecom carriers, finance and internet.
quarterly_data.figure: cloud product line RMB 6,476,855,244.59 (+455.34%, GM 55.22%); chips and boards sold 117,436 pieces (+201.57%); produced 127,673 pieces (+409.84%)

quarterly_data.signal: Stocking (2025 annual report): inventory RMB 4,943,532,510.26 at year-end, up 178.67% and 36.79% of total assets, mainly more raw materials; the single largest prepayee held 94.32% of prepayments (RMB 702,256,785.81). The company says domestic semiconductor raw-material prices have been rising overall and it will respond with strategic stocking and product iteration.
quarterly_data.figure: inventory RMB 4,943,532,510.26 (+178.67%); largest prepayee 94.32% of prepayments

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 R&D: R&D investment RMB 1,169,100,962.15, up 9.03%, 17.99% of revenue (91.30% in 2024); 887 R&D staff (80.13% of employees); cumulative investment in the cloud AI chip project RMB 2,887,632,524.94. The company gave Day 0 support to DeepSeek-V3.2 and adapted Qwen3-Next, Qwen3-VL, HunYuan, LongCat and GLM models. Raised-fund R&D projects: the large-model chip platform project (planned RMB 205,427.94 ten-thousand, 1.32% invested) and large-model software platform project (RMB 145,207.77 ten-thousand) are due to reach usable state in October 2028; the advanced-process platform chip project (85.54% invested) and stable-process platform chip project (74.05%) in May 2026.

Business plan (2025 annual report): the company will accelerate a series of chips for large-model tasks - chips for large-model training, for large-language-model inference, for multimodal inference, and switch chips for large-model needs - with a large-model software platform (compiler, training and inference platforms); it will build an advanced-package design technology platform for large-model chips, and aims to raise market share.
